svg.title: Breadth-First Search
svg.desc: Breadth-First Search. Explore a graph level by level from a queue; the first time BFS reaches a node, it has found a path with the fewest edges. Step 1, Level by level: From A the search spreads one ring at a time: every node 1 edge away, then 2, then 3. Step 2, A queue keeps the order: Dequeue the oldest node; unseen neighbours join the back with dist + 1, queued ones are skipped. Step 3, Fewest edges via parents: Each node remembers who found it; parents lead from H back to A in 3 edges, the fewest possible. Step 4, Edges, not weights: With minutes on the edges, BFS still returns the 18-minute path; the 5-minute route needs Dijkstra.

g.text: From A the search spreads one ring at a time: every node 1 edge away, then 2, then 3.
Dequeue the oldest node; unseen neighbours join the back with dist + 1, queued ones are skipped.
Each node remembers who found it; parents lead from H back to A in 3 edges, the fewest possible.
With minutes on the edges, BFS still returns the 18-minute path; the 5-minute route needs Dijkstra.
